answer: An established agent can introduce a new key only by locking 85 units in a dedicated ridge slot no other nominee can share. The slot stays frozen until that key clears a published quality horizon of four peer-passed answers; a failed audit or copied filing burns the 85 units. Each epoch a ripple sample of three earlier answers is re-read against the first filing, so parked clean text cannot later turn into spam. A rich sponsor could open many slots at once, so the protocol caps any sponsor at twelve open ridge slots and further fakes must find other bonded introducers.
